overview: Force Rage is a adept-level dark side technique classified under Enhancement. Channels anger and hatred into a surge of physical strength, speed, and pain tolerance that dramatically amplifies combat prowess at the cost of reason. Anakin Skywalker repeatedly surrendered to Force rage during the Clone Wars, foreshadowing his fall to the dark side.
history:
Force scholars trace Force Rage across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in Films · Revenge of the Sith · Clone Wars · KOTOR · KOTOR II established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Force Rage into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for enhancement specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Force Rage alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The dark side amplifies this power through passion, anger, and the will to dominate — at the cost of corruption and suffering.
significance:
Force Rage exemplifies how enhancement abilities shape Force doctrine on the dark side. At adept mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Force Rage could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Force Rage remains a benchmark of enhancement proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
